title: Yahtzee
chooseLength: How long should the game be?
shortHint: 6 rounds: ones to sixes. Good for practice.
wholeHint: 13 rounds: all fields of the score sheet.
mode_erklaeren: Explain mode: The coach shows the chances with every throw and explains where they come from.
mode_joker: Game with joker: You play yourself. When you are stuck, ask the joker. After every move the trainer tells you how it was.
mode_spielen: Plain game: no help, you collect points for the high-score list.
treeIntro: Free dice: {free}. How often is at least one {face} among them?
treeLabel: Probability tree for {free} free dice and the number {face}
twoIntro: And with two throws? Then no {face} may come in either throw.
tipField: and aim for {field}: about {points} points on average.
fieldsCompared: What the fields bring with these dice on average
noTree: There is no simple tree for this throw. Compare the fields.
jokerLevel1: Free dice: {free}. A way counts if at least one {face} is among them.
jokerLevel2: The branches are filled in. Chances along a way are multiplied.
jokerLevel3: Here is the solution. See how the ways fit together.
task1: Write the chance of each branch (as a fraction).
task2: Work out one way, then add up the green ways.
scoreBest: {field} with {points} points: that was the best choice.
scoreGood: {field} with {points} points: that is fine. {best} with {bestPoints} points would have been a little better.
scoreBetter: {field} with {points} points: {best} with {bestPoints} points would have been better here.
holdGood: Well kept: with these dice your chances are good.
holdBetter: With other dice the chances would have been a little better (about {lost} points).
coachNote: The coach works with the dice you keep. Tap dice and you see what comes of them.
coachNothing: You keep no die: all five are thrown again. Tap the dice you want to keep. Then I show you what comes of them.
coachAllHeld: You keep all five dice. This is what they bring in the fields:
coachNoThrow: You have no throw left. This is what the dice bring in the fields:
tipAim: you aim for {field}: about {points} points on average.
spreadIntro: Imagine you play exactly this position 100 times and aim for {field}. This is how often you end with:
spreadLabel: How often which points come out, {field}
spreadMean: The average of these 100 tries: about {points} points. That is what “on average” means.
stripLabel: The numbers 1 to 6: what you keep
stripHouse: A full house is three of one number and two of another. Numbers you already keep help you.
gridIntro: Each box is a possible throw of your free dice. Green means: {field} works.
gridCount: {ok} of {total} boxes are green: that many throws make {field} work.
gridTooBig: With {free} free dice there are {total} possible throws. That is too many to count by hand: the coach counted them all for you.
